card.name: Words right before allergy terms
card.fires_on: Short words like "an", "known", or "persons" that come just before an allergy or hypersensitivity term such as anaphylaxis, allergic reaction, or sensitive to latex. It appears in contraindication and warning text.

modes.label: "an" before anaphylaxis
modes.description: The article "an" (or the start of "an-aphylaxis") right before anaphylaxis or an allergic reaction.
modes.example: As with other vaccines, there is a small chance of<< an>> allergic reaction.

modes.label: "known" before hypersensitivity
modes.description: The word "known" that leads into hypersensitivity or allergy to a drug or dye.
modes.example: These include persons with a<< known>> allergy to contrast dye, severe congestive

modes.label: Group word before sensitivity
modes.description: A word naming people, right before "sensitive to" something.
modes.example: The needle cover should not be handled by<< persons>> sensitive to latex.

card.writes: It pushes the model to write allergy words such as allergic, allergy, hypersensitivity and sensitive next.
card.plain: It fires on the small word just before an allergy term is expected, such as "an" before anaphylaxis.
